description: The full Clawd agent stack as one installable skill: 203 skills and 17 connectors — Helius, DFlow, Imperial, Jupiter, Solana Tracker, BirdEye, OpenRouter, PayBox, Phoenix, wallet service, Pinata, Backpack, Composio, Nori, Clawd, GitHub, Firecrawl — through one guided flow, authenticated via our own musebook.trade OAuth (mcp-auth). Includes the live-bundle onboarding (Clawd live relay, Solana onboarding, browser-first wallet generation, Phoenix perps registration, live trading workflows, pump.fun agent API: coin creation, swaps, fees, tokenized-agent payments), one-shot install, and a browser-signing wallet policy (all signatures in the user browser wallet; local wallets only as named, scoped, user-approved exceptions).

mcp.note: OAuth 2.1 via our own musebook.trade authorization server. Sign in once with your Solana wallet (SIWS) at musebook.trade/developers to mint your API key, then authorize the connector. No per-service API keys needed for Musebook-native tools.

name: clawd
wallet_policy: browser-first: all signing in the user's browser wallet (Phantom/Backpack); local wallets only as named, scoped, user-approved exceptions
